type: ADDENDUM - reported secondary analysis only; does not change any rule, verdict, run, or stage gate
approval: Blake Jones via parent agent, 2026-11-25 9:22 AM CT: pre-declare paired-seed analysis as a reported secondary, never a verdict
data_state: No T-38 data exists at creation: 0 t38 terminal/launch records, 0 t38 audit events, 0 fwedu-bpe32k-s result files (checked at created_ct).
scope: every T-38 cell (rung x epochs, incl. lr-sweep cells only as description) where arms P and H share seeds

analysis.difference: d_s = BPB_H(s) - BPB_P(s) on fwedu32 test bpb_corpus, over the shared seeds s (negative = H better)
report: paired one-sided t = mean/SE with df n-1 (both directions' p reported)
Pearson r between arms over the shared seeds

verdicts: unchanged: Welch per T38_PREREG.json (headline and ladder rules, Holm). The paired analysis never decides PASS/KILL/PARITY/INCONCLUSIVE.
disagreement: If paired and Welch disagree, both are reported side by side with no override.
rationale: P and H at the same seed draw identical training windows (same tokenizer array, same seeded numpy generator), so seed-matched pairing may reduce noise; the T-37 h40-vs-s32 pooled within-cell r was -0.40 (different token arrays), so no correlation is assumed.
not_affected: Amendment 1 (L-fit rule) remains an unapproved DRAFT and is not part of this addendum.
